metadata.name: rebalance_pool
metadata.description: TwinYield rebalance pool — Liquity-style stability pool. Phase 5.

accounts.name: reward_vault
docs: Pool-owned vault that will hold deposited reward tokens.

accounts.name: user_base_ata
docs: User's base-token ATA. Gated to be owned by `user` so claims always
go to the caller — mirror of EVM `safeTransfer(msg.sender, ...)`.

accounts.name: base_mint
docs: Pool's base-token ATA. Required so `deposit` can sync any
unaccounted incoming base balance into the reward accumulator
BEFORE refreshing the depositor's snapshot. Without this sync,
a deposit landing between an arriving harvest and a separate
`sync_base_reward` call could capture a share of the harvest
reward without having staked through it (HIGH-severity finding
from the Phase-7 security review).

accounts.name: treasury_config
docs: Pulls the agFOGO + gFOGO mint pubkeys from twinyield's config.

accounts.name: pool_asset_ata
docs: Pool's agFOGO ATA — receives user deposits, gets debited in liquidation.

accounts.name: pool_base_ata
docs: Pool's gFOGO ATA — receives collateral on liquidation, paid out via claim.

accounts.name: base_checkpoint
docs: Base-reward checkpoint for the CURRENT `(epoch, scale)` at entry — the
cell this liquidation may freeze. Created lazily on first touch; mirrors
EVM `epochToScaleToBaseRewardSum[epoch][scale]`.

accounts.name: pool_asset_ata
docs: Pool's agFOGO ATA — gets debited by redeem.

accounts.name: pool_xtoken_ata
docs: Required by `twinyield::redeem` because redeem accepts either side
(and we have to fill the slot). Pool keeps it empty.

accounts.name: treasury_base_ata
docs: Treasury's base ATA — owned by treasury_config. Source of base tokens.

accounts.name: platform_base_ata
docs: Platform fee recipient.

accounts.name: pool_base_ata
docs: Pool's base ATA — receives the liquidation collateral.

instructions.name: sync_base_reward
docs: Permissionless. Absorbs any incoming base-token balance beyond the
pool's tracked expected into the reward accumulator. See
`instructions/sync.rs` for the harvest-pipeline narrative.

accounts.name: base_mint
docs: Pool's base-token ATA. Required so `deposit` can sync any
unaccounted incoming base balance into the reward accumulator
BEFORE refreshing the depositor's snapshot. Without this sync,
a deposit landing between an arriving harvest and a separate
`sync_base_reward` call could capture a share of the harvest
reward without having staked through it (HIGH-severity finding
from the Phase-7 security review).

accounts.name: user_base_ata
docs: User's base-token ATA — receives claimed base rewards when `do_claim`.

errors.name: StaleRewardSnapshot
errors.msg: extra-reward snapshot not settled; claim_extra before unlocking

errors.name: IncompleteRewardSettlement
errors.msg: must settle all registered extra-reward snapshots before unlocking

fields.name: user
docs: The user this depositor account belongs to.

fields.name: initial_deposit
docs: Active deposit (9-decimal SPL units). Mirrors EVM
`snapshots[user].initialDeposit`.

fields.name: initial_unlock_amount
docs: Amount currently unlocking (9-decimal). Mirrors
`snapshots[user].initialUnlock.amount`.

fields.name: initial_unlock_at
docs: Unix timestamp when the unlocking amount becomes withdrawable.

fields.name: snap_epoch
docs: Epoch snapshot at last interaction.

fields.name: snap_scale
docs: Scale snapshot at last interaction.

fields.name: snap_prod
docs: Product factor snapshot at last interaction.

fields.name: base_acc_rewards_per_stake
docs: Accumulated reward sum at last interaction, 1e18-scaled.

fields.name: base_pending
docs: Pending unclaimed base reward, 1e18-scaled (in base-token 9-decimal
units boosted by 1e9 — see `claim` for downscaling).

fields.name: extra_reward_count
docs: Number of extra-reward tokens this depositor has registered for (via
`register_user_reward`). When > 0, `unlock` (the only op that reduces
the extra-reward earning stake) requires every matching per-token
snapshot to be settled first — see
`instructions/deposit.rs::settle_extra_before_unlock`. Carved from the
former padding so the layout/offsets of every prior field are
unchanged (old accounts read 0, which is correct).

fields.name: last_time
docs: Unix timestamp (seconds) of the most recent `save_value` call.
EVM uses `uint40 block.timestamp`; on SVM we use `i64 Clock::unix_timestamp`.

fields.name: sample_interval
docs: Sample interval, in seconds. Matches `EMAStorage.sampleInterval`.

fields.name: last_value
docs: Last observed raw value, 1e18-scaled. Matches `EMAStorage.lastValue`.

fields.name: last_ema_value
docs: Last computed EMA value, 1e18-scaled. Matches `EMAStorage.lastEmaValue`.

types.name: ExtraRewardConfig
docs: Per-token streaming state for an extra reward token. Mirrors EVM
`RewardState` + the `rewardManager[token]` entry. One PDA per reward mint,
seeded `[EXTRA_REWARD_CONFIG_SEED, reward_mint]`.

fields.name: reward_mint
docs: The reward token mint.

fields.name: manager
docs: Authorized depositor of this reward (EVM `rewardManager[token]`).

fields.name: rate
docs: Current reward rate, token base-units per second (EVM `RewardState.rate`).

fields.name: period_length
docs: Length of a distribution period, seconds (EVM `periodLength`).

fields.name: last_update
docs: Last time `distribute` ran (EVM `lastUpdate`).

fields.name: finish_at
docs: Timestamp the current stream ends (EVM `finishAt`).

fields.name: queued
docs: Rewards queued while `total_supply == 0` (EVM `queued`).

fields.name: vault
docs: Pool's vault ATA holding this reward token (authority = pool_state).

fields.name: expected_balance
docs: Internal known balance of `vault`, to detect newly-deposited amounts.

types.name: FeeRatio
docs: Mint or redeem fee ratio. Ported from `Market.sol::FeeRatio`.
The fee actually applied is either `default_fee` (inside the stability
boundary) or `default_fee + extra_fee` (outside it), depending on the
direction — see `docs/01-protocol-overview.md::Fee model` for the table.

fields.name: default_fee
docs: Default fee, 1e18-scaled.

fields.name: extra_fee
docs: Extra fee delta, 1e18-scaled signed.

fields.name: admin
docs: Admin pubkey. Mirror of `Market.DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` holder.

fields.name: treasury_config
docs: Pointer to the TreasuryConfig PDA this market drives.

fields.name: platform
docs: Platform / fee recipient. Mirror of `Market.platform`.

fields.name: reserve_pool
docs: Optional reserve pool (`Market.reservePool`). `Pubkey::default()` =
"not set" sentinel.

fields.name: flags
docs: Packed pause flags. See [`flags`].

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

fields.name: admin
docs: Admin / governance pubkey.

fields.name: treasury_config
docs: Pointer to twinyield's `TreasuryConfig` PDA.

fields.name: market_config
docs: Pointer to twinyield's `MarketConfig` PDA.

fields.name: asset_mint
docs: The asset deposited into this pool — agFOGO mint.

fields.name: base_mint
docs: The base token paid out on liquidation — gFOGO mint.

fields.name: liquidator
docs: Whoever is allowed to call `liquidate`.

fields.name: liquidatable_cr
docs: 1e18-scaled CR threshold above which liquidation is rejected.

fields.name: unlock_duration
docs: Seconds between `unlock` and `withdraw_unlocked`.

fields.name: total_supply
docs: Total agFOGO deposited (9-decimal SPL units).

fields.name: total_unlocking
docs: Total agFOGO currently in the unlocking cool-down.

fields.name: last_asset_loss_error
docs: Liquity-style error correction term, 1e18-scaled.

fields.name: epoch
docs: Current epoch. Increments when the pool is fully drained by a
liquidation.

fields.name: scale
docs: Current scale within the current epoch. Increments when `prod` would
otherwise drop below `1e-9`.

fields.name: prod
docs: Running product factor. Starts at `PRECISION`, multiplied by
`(PRECISION - loss / total) / PRECISION` per liquidation.

fields.name: base_reward_sum
docs: Accumulated S for base reward at the *current* `(epoch, scale)`.
Past `(epoch, scale)` sums live in [`RewardSumCheckpoint`] PDAs.

fields.name: expected_base_balance
docs: Internal "known" balance of `pool_base_ata`. Maintained by:
* `liquidate` (+= base_out from CPI redeem)
* `claim_base` (-= claimed amount)
* `sync_base_reward` (resets to `pool_base_ata.amount` after
absorbing any unaccounted incoming tokens into the S accumulator)
Phase 6 introduces this — anything `pool_base_ata.amount > expected`
is "incoming harvest yield" awaiting distribution to depositors.

types.name: RewardSumCheckpoint
docs: One reward-sum checkpoint, keyed by `(epoch, scale)` via PDA seeds. Mirrors
a single cell of EVM `epochToScaleToBaseRewardSum[epoch][scale]` (and, for
the extra-reward subsystem, `epochToScaleToExtraRewardSum[token][epoch][scale]`,
keyed additionally by token in the seeds).
Created lazily (`init_if_needed`) on the first liquidation that touches the
`(epoch, scale)`, then frozen forever once the scale/epoch advances past it.

fields.name: epoch
docs: Epoch this checkpoint belongs to (redundant with the PDA seed; stored
for inspection / defense-in-depth).

fields.name: scale
docs: Scale within the epoch.

fields.name: sum
docs: Frozen accumulated S at `(epoch, scale)`, 1e18-convention (matches
`PoolState::base_reward_sum`).

types.name: TreasuryConfig
docs: Admin-owned, rarely-mutated configuration for the Treasury.

fields.name: admin
docs: Admin pubkey. Maps to `OwnableUpgradeable._owner` in the EVM source.

fields.name: market_authority
docs: The pubkey allowed to call mint / redeem on this treasury (mirror of
EVM `Treasury.market`, enforced by `onlyMarket`). Typically the
MarketConfig PDA.

fields.name: base_mint
docs: Base collateral mint (`Treasury.baseToken`).

fields.name: atoken_mint
docs: aToken mint (`Treasury.aToken`).

fields.name: xtoken_mint
docs: xToken mint (`Treasury.xToken`).

fields.name: price_oracle
docs: Price oracle account (`Treasury.priceOracle`).

fields.name: rate_provider
docs: Rate provider account (`Treasury.rateProvider`).

fields.name: beta
docs: aToken volatility multiple. Matches `Treasury.beta`. Set to `0` for
the canonical TwinYield deploy (fully stable aToken).

fields.name: base_token_cap
docs: Maximum allowed total base token deposit (`Treasury.baseTokenCap`).

fields.name: initial_mint_ratio
docs: 1e18-scaled ratio used to split the first joint mint into a/x.
Immutable in EVM (`Treasury.initialMintRatio`). Mirrored here.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

types.name: TreasuryRuntime
docs: Frequently-mutated treasury state. Updated on every mint/redeem.

fields.name: total_base_token
docs: Total base token held, in **unwrapped** units. Mirrors
`Treasury.totalBaseToken` exactly — the wrapped balance lives on the
Treasury's SPL ATA; this counter tracks the unwrapped equivalent.

fields.name: last_permissioned_price
docs: Last permissioned price captured by `initialize_price`. 1e18-scaled.
Mirrors `Treasury.lastPermissionedPrice`.

fields.name: ema_leverage_ratio
docs: EMA storage for the leverage ratio (`Treasury.emaLeverageRatio`).

fields.name: yt_reward_index
docs: PT/YT redesign (`docs/11-pt-yt-redesign-spec.md`): cumulative yield
reward per YT (aToken) unit, scaled by `PRECISION`. Bumped by `harvest`
(`+= surplus_w9 * PRECISION / atoken_supply_w9`). A holder's entitlement
is `balance_w9 * (yt_reward_index - reward_debt_index) / PRECISION`.

fields.name: yt_yield_reserve
docs: PT/YT redesign: wrapped 9-decimal gFOGO retained in the treasury as
unclaimed YT yield. Subtracted when computing fresh harvest surplus so
retained yield isn't double-counted; decremented by `claim_yield`.

fields.name: initialized_price
docs: Set to `true` after `initialize_price`. Mirrors the EVM
`require(lastPermissionedPrice == 0)` guard.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

types.name: UserRewardSnapshot
docs: Per-(user, reward-token) snapshot. Mirrors EVM
`snapshots[user].extraRewards[token]` (`UserRewardSnapshot`). Seeded
`[USER_REWARD_SEED, user, reward_mint]`.

fields.name: pending
docs: Pending unclaimed reward (token base-units), EVM `pending`.

fields.name: acc_rewards_per_stake
docs: Accumulated reward-sum snapshot at last interaction, EVM
`accRewardsPerStake`.

fields.name: snap_epoch
docs: Epoch/scale/prod snapshot at last refresh — a self-contained copy of the
depositor's epoch state so this token's gain can be computed
independently (EVM keeps these in the shared `snapshots[user].epoch`).

fields.name: snap_deposit
docs: The compounded deposit at last refresh — the stake that earns this
token's reward over the next window (EVM uses `initialDeposit`; extra
rewards accrue to deposits only, not the unlocking pile).
